description: The plot illustrates MRR@10 performance as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), comparing four DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10, shown at regular tick intervals of 2 (2, 4, 6, 8, 10). The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. A black solid horizontal reference line labeled “DPR w/o query” sits at approximately 34.2 across all x values. The red line with circular markers (solid) labeled “DPR w/ corpus expansion” rises from about 35.1 at S=1 to about 35.5 at S=2, then increases gradually to around 35.7–35.8 by S=6–7, stays near that level through S=10 (ending around 35.8). The green line with upward triangle markers (solid) labeled “DPR w/ document expansion” stays nearly flat, starting around 34.8 at S=1 and remaining close to 34.8–34.9 through S=10 (ending around 34.8). The blue line with star markers (solid) labeled “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” fluctuates: it starts near 34.8 at S=1, reaches about 35.0 at S=2, drops to about 34.7 at S=3–4, returns to about 35.0 at S=5, then declines overall with small oscillations to about 34.4 by S=10.
